memo: New part on the 0.440 base, CPU kernel (GPU quota spent until 10-17). Base: canqiang/casmi26-e006-window-40-ice-fallback-true v1 (public LB 0.440, Apache-2.0), base cells unchanged except the CPU edits (as e3fg05c-1 = 0.432, whose fragment re-rank on the blind molecules is kept). Ours, new signal: neutral-loss substructure evidence (ours_nl.py). A peak at precursor m/z - L for 16 diagnostic losses (hexose 162.053, glucuronic acid 176.032, SO3, H3PO4, CO2, NH3, CH3 radical, acetyl, ...) is matched to the group's SMARTS in each candidate; P(loss seen | group) and P(loss seen | no group) were measured by us on train (NP-rich libraries, e.g. hexose 0.138 vs 0.004, H3PO4 0.198 vs 0.0004). The final top 25 are re-ranked by z(-log rank) + 0.5 x naive-Bayes log likelihood (raw nats) on every molecule with a seen loss (28 of 400). Held-out NP check (250 molecules, same-formula train isomers): MRR 0.327 vs 0.288 random on the 78 molecules it separates. Hypothesis: LB > 0.432 (bronze 0.441).
